column1: # TITLE: 24h-response to bevacizumab erlortinib in non-small cell lung cancer from blood-based exon array profiling

# SUMMARY: The mechanisms of action of the combined targeted therapy bevacizumab erlotinib in late stage non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer was investigated by means of whole genome exon arrays. mRNA from peripherial blood was extracted at baseline and 24h after initiation of the therapy and hybridized on Affymetrix Human Exon 1.0 ST Arrays
